title: What's New in WorshipFlow ✨
message: Here's what's new and improved — fresh from the latest update:

highlights: 🎬 Offline Video Backgrounds — Upload videos directly to the local server for use in Live Stage, with zero dependency on cloud storage. Perfect for camp environments with no internet.
📋 Event Pre-Save Preview — Before saving any scheduled event, you can now preview a full summary of what the email and push notification will look like — no more surprises.
👥 Team Templates Overhaul — Team Templates now show live profile photos of members, fixed member picker, and a polished modern card layout with hover effects.
🔒 Modal Scroll Lock — Modals (Team Templates, Event Review) now properly lock the background, preventing accidental page scroll while a modal is open.
📐 Dashboard Grid Fix — Verse of the Day and My Tasks now share a smart 2-column layout that adapts when tasks are present, eliminating wasted space.
🔄 Live Sync Fix — Fixed the 'slide click wipes settings' bug. All Live Stage settings (marquee, font scaling, fade screens) now persist correctly across online and offline modes.
🎞 Video Thumbnails — The Media Library now generates canvas-captured video thumbnails on upload, replacing black frames with real previews.
⚡ Typewriter Fix — Corrected text clipping during typewriter animation in the OBS browser source by adding word-break handling.
🏕 Camp Readiness Check — Verified that offline asset availability checks work correctly without triggering false negatives in production.
🎂 Birthday Cards — A role-themed birthday card automatically pops up for celebrating teammates, complete with a personalized message and Bible verse.
💌 Send Wishes — Write a personal birthday note to the celebrant. They'll see all messages in a dedicated wish feed on their card, and get notified in real time.
📢 Notify Team Button — Admins and Leaders can now send a schedule notification email to the entire team directly from any event panel. A 24-hour cooldown prevents duplicate sends.
▶ Mini Player Persistence — Videos minimized to the floating mini player now continue playing seamlessly as you navigate the app.
📖 Listen to Lineup — A new button on the dashboard lets you listen to your worship team's song lineup for upcoming services, with auto-advance and loop.
🎵 I've Listened Tracking — Each song in the lineup has an 'I've Listened' button. Mark songs you've prepared and see who else on the team has listened.
